name: Guild Copier
description: Right-click a server's icon: Copy Guild makes a new server with the same roles, channels, categories, permissions, emojis and stickers; Transfer To does the same into a server you already have, after DELETING all its roles and channels. Both ask first. Made for copying a server that is yours.
